title: Cambridge IELTS 18 Academic Speaking Test 2 (Online Test)

parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask general questions about yourself and a few familiar topics. Answer naturally and try to extend each answer with a reason or example. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: Did you like studying science when you were at school? [Why/Why not?]
What do you remember about your science teachers at school?
How interested are you in science now? [Why/Why not?]
What do you think has been an important recent scientific development? [Why?]

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You will be given a topic card. You have one minute to prepare and may make notes. Then speak for one to two minutes. Try to keep talking until the examiner stops you.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe a tourist attraction in your country that you would recommend.
cue_card_bullets: where in your country this tourist attraction is
what visitors can see and do at this tourist attraction
and explain why you would recommend this tourist attraction

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the Part 2 topic. These are more abstract and require you to explain, compare, and speculate. Try to give extended, well-reasoned answers. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: What are the most popular museums and art galleries where you live?
Do you believe that all museums and art galleries should be free?
What kinds of things make a museum or art gallery an interesting place to visit?
Why, do you think, do some people book package holidays rather than travelling independently?
Would you say that large numbers of tourists cause problems for local people?
What sort of impact can large holiday resorts have on the environment?
